remarks: Single Family with legal accessory apartment. New 5 bedroom septic system- just installed and new furnace and hot water heater in apartment. Let your imagination soar in creating your ideal situation. The main house and the accessory apartment each has a fireplace, The main house has 3 bedrooms and the apartment 2 bedrooms and each has 2 full baths. Hardwood Floors, laminate floor, vinyl floor, parquet floors, carpeted floors and even slate floors nicely accent the various rooms in the property. A pleasant balcony, an elevated deck and lush gardens are a few of the outdoor features. Close to all that matters, the town, shopping and the Merritt. Back on the market because of denial of financing no fault of home.
